landforms.note: The Pleasure Dome of the Bay's island in Erehwon's bay: the Erewhon page's island (settlements/xanadu, target erewhon, ISLAND_C at 70,-613 m from the page's centre, which stands on Erehwon's pin 805,1516 unturned), about 220 x 110 m and 14 m over the lake, some 150 m off the world's shore (the owner, 2026-11-11: keep the page, move the record; it stays off the quays, about 0.6 km). No shoal: its rounded cell is the shore bench. Stamped at 1:1 by openworld/xanadu-oidong-highrift/src/44-world-landforms.js. edit_517 (first run as edit_512 on claude/openworld-sites, 2026-11-11).
A basalt stack off the lake's west shore, 42 m over the water. Sub-cell; its cell's bed held as a shoal. edit_517, 2026-11-11.

Phēr's headland (the owner, 2026-11-16: "give it a headland and cove"): the arm from the shore's bend west of the town, its rise joining the bench; the cove lies east of it. settlements/pher/PLAN.md section 1.2, edit_517_pher.py.
